mapper.sql: SELECT q.id, q.question_type, q.subject_id, s.name AS subject_name, q.score, q.difficult, q.source_name, q.source_year, q.source_question_no, q.source_ref, q.stem_html, q.analysis_html, q.stem_text, q.correct, q.answer_text, q.status, q.status_reason, q.display_ready, q.license_tag, q.batch_id, b.batch_tag, q.create_time, q.update_time FROM question q LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id = q.subject_id LEFT JOIN import_batch b ON b.id = q.batch_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (question_type, subject_id, score, difficult, source_name, source_year, source_question_no, source_ref, stem_html, analysis_html, stem_text, correct, answer_text, status, status_reason, display_ready, license_tag, batch_id) VALUES (#{questionType}, #{subjectId}, #{score}, #{difficult}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceYear}, #{sourceQuestionNo}, #{sourceRef}, #{stemHtml}, #{analysisHtml}, #{stemText}, #{correct}, #{answerText}, #{status}, #{statusReason}, #{displayReady}, #{licenseTag}, #{batchId})

SELECT q.id, q.question_type, s.name AS subject_name, q.source_name, q.source_year, q.source_question_no, q.stem_text, q.correct, q.status, q.display_ready, q.license_tag, b.batch_tag, q.create_time FROM question q LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id = q.subject_id LEFT JOIN import_batch b ON b.id = q.batch_id
ORDER BY q.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT source_year AS stat_key, COUNT(*) AS stat_count FROM question GROUP BY source_year ORDER BY source_year
SELECT question_type AS stat_key, COUNT(*) AS stat_count FROM question GROUP BY question_type ORDER BY question_type
SELECT status AS stat_key, COUNT(*) AS stat_count FROM question GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
